start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa pasand hai?

turns.reply: Perimeter yani kisi shape ki boundary ki total length; shape ke sabhi sides jodte hain. Aap ise fence ya lace jaisa sochiye—boundary ke chaaron taraf. Ab aap batayiye: perimeter mein kaunsi sides jodenge?
Kabir, perimeter nikalne ke liye polygon ki har side ki length ek-ek karke jodiye. Aapke hisaab se rectangle ki kaunsi sides jodenge?
